ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar focuses on animal training techniques and will provide students with the opportunity to practice training techniques hands-on with a variety of animals. Students will learn safe handling practices and communication strategies. This class is perfect for anyone interested in working in the field of animal training and is designed with practical application in mind. Occasional field trips and off-campus sessions will be required; students will be expected to arrange their own transportation.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
